chapters.title: 第1章　一
chapters.text:
吾輩は猫です。名前はまだありません。どこで生まれたか分かりません。暗い所でニャーニャー泣いていました。その時、初めて人を見ました。

男の人の手の上で、吾輩の目が回りました。吾輩は笹原の中へ捨てられました。兄弟も母もいません。吾輩は池を左に見ながら、ゆっくり歩き、人の家へ入りました。女の人は吾輩を何度も外へ出しましたが、吾輩は台所へ入りました。主人は吾輩を見て、「家の中に置いてやれ」と言いました。吾輩はこの家に住むことにしました。

segments.meaning_en: does not exist; there is not

form_steps.label: polite negative
form_steps.meaning_en: does not exist; is not present

segments.conjugation_form: て-form + progressive いる, polite past

segments.meaning_en: marks the object of the action

segments.dictionary_definition_en: to be present; to exist (of living things)
to let out; to send out

segments.meaning_en: put it there as a favor

form_steps.label: て-form + benefactive
form_steps.meaning_en: do the placing as a favor

form_steps.label: benefactive imperative
form_steps.meaning_en: put it there as a favor

grammar_overlays.pattern: 疑問詞 + 場所 + Vた + か
grammar_overlays.explanation_en: どこで生まれたか forms an embedded question meaning “where someone was born.”

components.function_en: question word specifying the unknown place
marks the place of being born
past predicate plus か, making the question embedded

grammar_overlays.explanation_en: 男の人 is a conventional expression meaning “man.”
The fixed expression 目が回る means to become dizzy; here it is in the polite past.

components.function_en: marks the subject of the expression
means turned/spun in the fixed expression

grammar_overlays.explanation_en: ながら attaches to the verb stem to show that the action happens while another action is performed.
A conventional noun phrase meaning “woman,” made from 女 (female/woman) and 人 (person), linked by の.

components.function_en: links the modifier to the noun

grammar_overlays.meaning_en: do V as a favor for someone
grammar_overlays.explanation_en: 置いて means ‘place it’, while やれ is the imperative form of the benefactive helper やる, expressing that the action is done as a favor for someone.

components.function_en: imperative benefactive helper: do it as a favor for someone
components.dictionary_definition_en: to do; to give or perform as a favor

grammar_overlays.explanation_en: ことにする expresses deciding to do the preceding verb; here, deciding to live in the house.

components.function_en: expresses the decision, in polite past form

materiality_audit.policy: literary/story vocabulary is diagnostic, not a hard failure
